content.short: DeFi Land is a multi-chain agriculture-simulation game with DeFi app interactions.
content.description: DeFi Land reimagines Farmville as a blockchain game built around play-to-earn mechanics, allowing players to earn the native DFL token by completing tasks and milestones. The experience blends farming with genuine DeFi activities, letting players interact with automated market makers, decentralized exchanges, and lending and borrowing protocols—all integrated into the gameplay. Backed by notable investors, the title invites players to grow digital assets in a connected, economy-driven world where strategy and finance converge in an engaging, immersive environment.
